# Melon Patch

> Melon Patch is a small independent studio making games and software. Founded in 2026, operated by Melon Patch LLC. Its first game is TUG Co., a calm puzzle game for iOS and Android.

## Products

- [TUG Co.](https://melonpatch.dev/tug/): A calm puzzle game for iOS and Android. Tug rows left and right to bring every keystone home. Some rows move together, others move against one another. It holds more than 80,000 free puzzles across the Base campaign and the Heavy Gear pack, all openable by playing, three new Daily puzzles arrive every day in Normal, Hard, and Hell difficulties, and there are no timers and no fail states. Every puzzle mode plays fully offline, including the campaign, Daily puzzles, Practice, and hints. No account required; progress is stored on the device. Accessibility: text size up to 200 percent, UI scaling, reduced motion support, and visual cues that do not rely on color alone. Status: Coming Soon.

## TUG Co. pages

- [TUG Co. support](https://melonpatch.dev/tug/support.html): Help with saved progress, purchases, offline play, and hints.
- [TUG Co. privacy policy](https://melonpatch.dev/tug/privacy.html): The game collects no personal information. The only data that leaves the device is anonymous crash reports and, for purchases, the store receipt.
- [TUG Co. press kit](https://melonpatch.dev/tug/press.html): Factsheet, description, features, and media.
- [TUG Co. for parents](https://melonpatch.dev/tug/for-parents.html): No ads, no chat, no personal data collection, honest detail on optional purchases, and full offline play.
- [Accessibility in TUG Co.](https://melonpatch.dev/tug/accessibility.html): Text size up to 200 percent, UI scaling, reduced motion support, color-independent cues, no timers, and no fail states.

## About

Melon Patch makes a small number of things and tries to make them well. No bloat, no hype.

- Philosophy: Ship small. Iterate fast. Care deeply.
- Focus: Games, creative software, small useful tools.
- Structure: Remote-first independent studio.

## FAQ

### What is Melon Patch?
Melon Patch is a small independent studio making games and software, founded in 2026 and operated by Melon Patch LLC.

### What is TUG Co.?
TUG Co. is a calm puzzle game for iOS and Android. You tug rows left and right to bring every keystone home. Some rows move together and others move against one another. It holds more than 80,000 free puzzles, all openable by playing, three new Daily puzzles arrive every day, and there are no timers and no fail states. Every puzzle mode plays fully offline and no account is required.

### Is TUG Co. free?
Yes, the game and every one of its more than 80,000 puzzles. The Base campaign is open from the start, and the Heavy Gear pack is earned and opened with Gold you get from playing. Real money only buys Gold faster; no puzzle ever requires it.

### Does TUG Co. have ads?
No. TUG Co. shows no ads.

### Can TUG Co. be played offline?
Yes. Every puzzle mode plays fully offline. Only purchasing needs a connection.

### Is TUG Co. suitable for children and older players?
TUG Co. is a general-audience game with no violence, no chat, no social features, and no ads. There are no timers and no fail states, text size goes up to 200 percent, and visual cues never rely on color alone.
